Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a list of health care providers willing to serve as volunteer resources during an emergency or disaster.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a list of health care providers willingto serve as volunteer resources; adding a new section to chapter 18.122RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.122 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Application forms for initial or renewal licensure,certification, or registration to a health care profession must containa provision asking the applicant whether or not he or she grantspermission to the department to forward his or her name, profession,and contact information to the military department as a possiblevolunteer resource to be contacted in the event of a bioterroristincident, natural disaster, or other emergency or disaster, as definedin RCW 38.52.010, that requires the services of health care providers. (2) The department shall maintain lists of all applicants who grantthe department permission under subsection (1) of this section. Atleast once every year, the department shall send the militarydepartment a list of the names, professions, and contact information p. 1 HB 1849for these health care providers.
